The absence of any build.fsx invocation was established by reading both workflow files in full, not by a single grep; the two files are the complete contents of .github/workflows/.

Re-verified after #48 landed mid-cycle and added a feedback-tool selftest step to verify.yml: the workflow now has three steps and still invokes build.fsx in none of them, so the finding stands against a new digest.

The three-way convergence rests on coordination messages received during the cycle and on tool output observed at the time. The tool output is reproducible; the composition of that particular wave is not, and the messages are quoted rather than bound.
The two critics' reports are not committed artifacts; what is bound here is the resulting source and the checkpoint record. The mutation results are reproducible against the committed build.fsx.
